text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Morning at Tracen Academy. The Umamusume 
put running aside and devote themselves to 
their studies.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, classroom lectures, huh? What a 
drag. As long as I run fast, isn't that 
good enough?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san, take this seriously. This is 
one of our duties, too.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it! That's it! Turbo's gonna 
do it too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I get it already. Let's see 
here, the question is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“—'Fill in the blank with the appropriate 
phrase: Never put off until tomorrow what 
you can ______ today.' ...Huh.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ha, as if I'd know... Pass—!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is simple. "Never put 
off till tomorrow what you can do today," 
right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, that's kinda boring. In that case... 
I'll just fill it in my own way."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Got no interest in what can be done 
today," and... sent. Well, that should do 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's not it at all, you two. Aren't you 
forgetting something important?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Whether we put it off until tomorrow or 
aren't interested— there are things far 
more important than that."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"What we can do today is 'have fun'," 
right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Have fun...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Day in and day out, we chase only 
results, and we almost end up 
forgetting...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, the most important thing is having 
fun every day. So if you're not in the 
mood for classroom study, just do the bare 
minimum, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Teio-san. Are you just making up a 
heartwarming story because you don't want 
to study?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hm! Then how would you write it, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This is my answer: 'What can be done 
today, I already finished yesterday.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected... An Umamusume who 
surpasses the number one 'me', standing at 
center zero...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us wait for the announcement 
to see whose answer was deemed exemplary.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, the most wonderful answer goes to— 
Twin Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: W-What did you write?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, here's Turbo's answer! "What you 
can do today—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'll do it today!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-So strong... Because it's dead simple... 
it somehow feels crazy strong...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a second...!? Turbo-san's just has 
momentum, and it's simply skilled 
calligraphy!
